# Exponential Integrals

![Exponential Integrals function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/exponential-integrals/00_Repertoire%20Exponential%20integrals.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Six fixed real integral functions after Elliptic Integrals. En has a required integer order; Si keeps signed x. Profile ni_documented_real_v1: Si uses signed x; En, Ci, Dilogarithm, Shi and Chi use q=abs(x). Standard Shi is odd, but the documented node adapter applies abs(x). En is E_n, not Ei; D(q)=-Li2(1-q), not Li2(q) or positive Spence. NI parity has not been measured.

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Exponential Integral](../../math/special/exponential_integrals/expn.md) | Evaluates E_n(q)=integral(1,infinity,exp(-q*t)/t^n,dt), q=abs(x), with required integer n&gt;=0 and no default order. E0(q)=exp(-q)/q; E0(0) and E1(0) are +Infinity with singularity; En(0)=1/(n-1) for n&gt;=2. E1(710) remains a representable subnormal. |
| [Sine Integral](../../math/special/exponential_integrals/si.md) | Evaluates Si(x)=integral(0,x,sin(t)/t,dt) in radians with signed x. Si(0)=0, Si(-1)=-0.946083070367183 and Si(+infinity)=pi/2. |
| [Cosine Integral](../../math/special/exponential_integrals/ci.md) | Evaluates real Ci(abs(x)), including Euler gamma plus log(q) normalization. Ci(0)=-Infinity with singularity, Ci(1)=0.3374039229009681; this is not Cin or a complex continuation. |
| [Dilogarithm](../../math/special/exponential_integrals/dilogarithm.md) | Evaluates D(q)=-Li2(1-q)=integral(1,q,ln(t)/(t-1),dt), q=abs(x), following the NI/CVI equation. D(0)=-pi^2/6, D(1)=0 and D(2)=pi^2/12; t=1 is removable. |
| [Hyperbolic Sine Integral](../../math/special/exponential_integrals/shi.md) | Evaluates Shi(abs(x))=integral(0,abs(x),sinh(t)/t,dt). Standard Shi is odd, but this documented adapter uses abs(x): Shi(-1)=+1.0572508753757286. Shi(0)=0; a scaled algorithm preserves finite Shi(717). |
| [Hyperbolic Cosine Integral](../../math/special/exponential_integrals/chi.md) | Evaluates real Chi(abs(x)) with Euler gamma plus log(q) normalization. Chi(0)=-Infinity with singularity; Chi(1)=0.8378669409802082. A scaled algorithm preserves finite Chi(717). |
